references.name: Bikepark RKF El Durazno
references.reason: Identifies the park by name and official website, for broad map location only. It is about 171 m from the OSM entrance node; it is not an entrance or trail junction.

references.name: OSM entrance
references.reason: Node is tagged as an entrance and shared by a fence and Sendero Subida Buitrera. Candidate gate location in OSM; exact correspondence with the operator entry address and photographed operations area is not validated.

references.name: Buitrera
references.reason: Named viewpoint matches a label visible in the photograph. No pixel/world control pair established. It is about 51 m from the separately mapped Virgen statue.

references.name: Virgen
references.reason: Named statue may explain the Virgin icon by Buitrera. It is a point feature, not the entire La Virgen trail or an independently surveyed anchor.

references.name: Plaza de Los Saltos
references.reason: Named viewpoint is separate from the nearby information-map node by about 18.5 m. Do not exchange the viewpoint icon and trail junction as an anchor.

references.name: Bikepark El Durazno
references.reason: This is an information-map node, not a park-wide centroid or access. OSM paths Lomo Vetado, Calibre 12 and Los Saltos share this endpoint; a common graph node does not identify a pixel in the sign.

references.name: Subida Buitrera / conexión
references.reason: Shared endpoint of OSM ways 477168992 and 477174834, close to Buitrera viewpoint. This node has no place-name tag; do not replace the viewpoint coordinate with it.

references.name: Conexiones / Sendero XL
references.reason: Shared endpoint of OSM ways 477174834, 477174835 and 477174836. Names differ from some map labels; correspondence to a photographed junction remains unvalidated.

references.name: Lomo Vetado / conexión
references.reason: Endpoint of OSM Lomo Vetado way 477170097 and connection way 477174836. Candidate topology reference only; not a verified image control point.

references.name: Calibre 12 / Lomo Vetado
references.reason: Node belongs to OSM Lomo Vetado way 477170097 and is an endpoint of Calibre 12 way 1003300258. Graph connectivity verified; correspondence to the drawing not validated.

openMappingCheck.result: The retained OSM snapshot has Sendero Lomo Vetado (way 477170097, v6). No exact named Starwars or La Virgen trail was found; the named Conexión Calibre 12-La Virgen is not treated as the complete La Virgen trail.

restrictedProviderCheck.result: The published Data Use Policy requires authorized API access for data use. No API key was requested and no coordinates, tracks or geometry were imported.
